section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes instruments used to assess state body appreciation and related constructs: a state-adapted version of the 10-item BAS-2 (SBAS-2), the six-item Body Image States Scale (BISS), the five-item Satisfaction With Life Scale (SWLS), the Single-Item Self-Esteem Scale (SISE), and calculation of BMI from self-reported height and weight. The section reports internal consistency for some scales (e.g., BISS α = .84; SWLS α = .94) but provides no sample demographics, sample size, survey mode, country, or any correlations between body appreciation and BMI; no explicit study numbering is provided.
section_summary.evidence_source: The 10-item Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2; Tylka & Wood-Barcalow, 2015) was used as the basis for the SBAS-2. Participants reported their height and weight, which were used to calculate body mass index. Cronbach's alpha for this study was .84. In this study, Cronbach's alpha was .94.
